name: tezcat
description: Implements a remembrance agent using keyword and semantic search. Surface thoughts related to your current work from around your vault. Look into the mirror.

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-japanese-dict.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/package-trial.mjs
